citations.claim: SDK provides secret resolution, table utilities, and tool context management as its primary API
ToolContext dataclass contains name, secrets dict, thread_key, and container_id fields
Secret resolution follows three-tier fallback: tool context → backend → default → KeyError
SecretBackend abstract base class defines async get() and list_keys() methods
StubBackend returns key names as values for firewall injection in server mode
EnvBackend reads secrets from os.environ for CLI mode
Registry auto-configures StubBackend by default for server security
JsonFormatter produces structured single-line JSON logs with timestamp and service fields
render_text_table provides plain-text table formatting with auto-sized columns
save_attachment uploads binary data to Centaur API with Base64 encoding
Rich library (>=13.0) is the only required external dependency
current_thread_key() extracts thread identifier from tool context for scoped operations
Context management uses Python contextvars for thread-safe tool isolation
get_sync() method handles both async and sync execution contexts using thread pools
Attachment upload uses urllib.request to POST to Centaur API with JSON payload
